cohort: Antenatal English-speaking women attending a public hospital antenatal clinic.
finding: Around half of women scoring 'high' on either general or pregnancy-specific anxiety measures at the first assessment continued to score high a few weeks later, indicating enduring anxiety, while the other half experienced transient anxiety.
cross-section timing: First assessment (T1) and a follow-up assessment (T2) 2-6 weeks later, both during pregnancy.
